checks: ground-truth points use flat unambiguous surfaces
a survey contains a few hundred verification points
each ground-truth point is approximately plus-or-minus 3cm RMSE
metadata includes survey date surface type survey method transformation and geoidal model
ground truth should be less than 5 years old for general reuse
coastal-project ground truth should be less than 3 years old
LIDAR survey QC requires less than plus-or-minus 15cm RMSE
LIDAR survey QC also requires standard deviation and random error within 10cm
promotion_rule: Reject stale or failed ground-truth QC when a timestamped survey is used for parcel elevation.
